Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a targeted protein pull-down (immunoprecipitation of MRE11) followed by in-gel digestion and DDA LC-MS/MS to identify cleavage sites. While the study focuses on a protein truncation (TR-MRE11), this is a result of proteolytic cleavage, not a PTM-enrichment workflow like phospho or ubiquitylome. The search parameters include standard variable modifications.

scope: For immunoprecipitations, 10 mg lysate was precleared with protein A/G dynabeads (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, CA) at 4°C for 60 min. Lysates were incubated overnight with anti-MRE11 antibody (ab214) then added to protein A/G beads (40µl) at 4°C for 2 h.
After instant blue staining, bands corresponding to FL- or TR-MRE11 were excised from the gel, cut into small pieces and subjected to an in-gel-digest process.
